scope: Bounded read-only local source/manpage/ZIP/class-constant inspection. No native command, JVM, javap, strace, bwrap, namespace or network probe; no code or original artifact edits. Only this JSON/Markdown written.

C4.observed: All inspected compiled-directory ancestors are writable by current host user. Existing Foreman strong containment creates user/PID namespaces and mount-proc; it does not protect worktree files. Existing runner delegates arbitrary bound argv to that launcher and has no filesystem-policy field.
C4.availablePrimitive: Installed /usr/bin/bwrap and its local manpage document --ro-bind SRC DEST, --ro-bind-data FD DEST (copies bytes to read-only mounted file), --tmpfs, --perms, --size, --remount-ro and --disable-userns. Installation/docs do not establish successful nested runtime.
C4.unsafeShortcut: A read-only bind of the original directory protects child writes but shares host inodes. It cannot exclude host mutation, deletion of files within it or changes before the mount. chmod or a preflight hash is not temporal protection; no such modification was performed.
C4.minimumOption: For C4 alone, review an ephemeral private directory skeleton covering the compiled-path ancestors and a --ro-bind-data snapshot of syntaxDefinition.kore at its same absolute path. Read and hash the exact snapshot; enforce a regular non-symlink source. Parent directories and snapshot must be unmodifiable by child after setup, and pathname replacement from the host must not alter the private skeleton. A mere ro-bind of the live directory without private snapshot is insufficient against external writers.
C4.coherentOption: If temporal integrity is required for all consumed compiled artifacts (also configVars.sh/backend.txt/mainModule.txt), create a private exact-byte snapshot of the entire 488-file compiled tree under its same absolute path, with original executable modes and protected private ancestors. Existing --ro-bind-data is a primitive, not a complete ready invocation. Local measured files total 30,309,653 bytes; syntaxDefinition.kore alone is 260,431 bytes. Account descriptors, memory/copying, temporary storage, modes, symlinks, mount ordering and private task temp separately. Originals remain untouched. Snapshot inode/provenance differs and must be explicit.
C4.contractImpact: This adds filesystem isolation and snapshot preparation, which proposal02 currently disfavors and does not authorize implicitly. It need not add a collector or modify runner/Foreman: a bounded exec-only setup stage can stay beneath existing Foreman via reviewed argv. It does require additional source/tool/dependency hashes, snapshot provenance, containment/uid-map revalidation and an explicitly reviewed design/argv/candidate amendment. HOME string and host files can remain unchanged. No availability or 20-second fit claim is supported yet.
C4.requiredOfflineControls: Separately authorized harmless nested bwrap control must establish child write/rename failure, survival of private snapshot despite host source replacement, correct regular-file/mode/path identity, no escape/remount, exact rehash after setup, unchanged HOME, and existing strong containment. No native K may substitute for these controls.

Keep application/runtime config reachability unresolved; classpath-only claim is too broad.
